recommended_paper.title: Tool Use Before Teamwork: A Cost-Aware and Auditable Evaluation of LLM Architectures for Financial Numerical Reasoning
recommended_paper.paper_type: controlled empirical systems study with exploratory failure analysis
recommended_paper.central_claim_to_test: Tool augmentation can improve executable financial reasoning, whereas adding fixed agent roles does not automatically improve reliability and may introduce coordination and verification failures.
recommended_paper.confirmatory_comparison: B1 Tool-Augmented Single Agent versus B0 Direct LLM
recommended_paper.exploratory_component: B2 fixed-role multi-agent development failures and verifier false acceptance
not_claimed: B2 development results are final held-out performance
the 30-item development differences are statistically significant
observed differences are causal effects of architecture alone

frozen_development_evidence.role: hypothesis generation and engineering diagnosis only

research_questions.question: Does tool augmentation improve final-answer and execution accuracy over direct generation on held-out financial numerical reasoning items?
What quality-cost trade-offs arise from retrieval and deterministic calculation tools?
Which coordination, evidence-contract, output-budget, and verification failures explain the underperformance of the fixed-role multi-agent prototypes?
How stable are B0 and B1 outcomes under repeated calls to a provider alias without an exposed immutable model snapshot?

hypotheses.statement: B1 has higher held-out final-answer accuracy than B0.
hypotheses.origin: formed from development evidence before inspecting the held-out test outcomes

hypotheses.statement: B1 has higher held-out execution accuracy and execution coverage than B0.
B1 requires more model calls and total tokens per item than B0, but tool execution reduces program-construction errors.

historical_development_set.action: freeze permanently; no further prompt or architecture tuning from item outcomes

recommended_primary_sample.selection: operation- and step-depth-stratified deterministic SHA-256 ranking
recommended_primary_sample.rare_strata_rule: minimum quotas for comparison, exponentiation, table operations, and four/five-step programs; remaining quotas proportional to the held-out pool
recommended_primary_sample.gold_use: gold programs may define strata only; gold answers, evidence, and programs never enter inference prompts

stability_subset.selection: deterministic hash-ranked subset of the primary sample
stability_subset.purpose: estimate stochastic outcome and resource variability; not pooled into the primary test

dataset_plan.ideal_high_budget_option: run the primary comparison once on all 1,147 FinQA test items

system_freeze.B0: freeze the accepted B0-v1.2 direct-LLM configuration with corrected official evidence-label presentation
system_freeze.B1: freeze the accepted B1-v1.2 tool-augmented single-agent configuration
system_freeze.B2: do not make additional paid calls; retain B2-v1 and v1.1 as exploratory failed development systems
common: same 32,768 cumulative output ceiling per item
same evaluator and official evidence identifiers
same item order with deterministic interleaving of B0 and B1 to reduce temporal provider drift
record timestamps, returned model identifier, tokens, latency, errors, and request hashes

inference_blinding.design: create answer-stripped runtime JSONL for inference and keep gold in a separately hashed evaluation artifact loaded only after predictions are immutable
guards: assert no gold_answer, gold_program, or gold_evidence key enters any request payload
verify sample identity and order independently

efficiency: model and tool calls per item
input, output, reasoning, and total tokens per item
tokens and latency per correct answer

statistical_plan.primary_test: two-sided exact McNemar test on paired B0/B1 correctness at alpha=0.05
statistical_plan.effect_reporting: absolute percentage-point difference, paired odds ratio, and 95% confidence interval
statistical_plan.secondary_metrics: paired item bootstrap with 10,000 resamples; Holm adjustment across the key secondary family
statistical_plan.resource_metrics: paired bootstrap and distribution summaries; do not rely on normality
statistical_plan.heterogeneity: predefined operation, step-depth, table/arithmetic, and evidence-count strata; exploratory with confidence intervals
statistical_plan.stability_analysis: report per-system item-level success frequency and token/latency dispersion over the three stability-subset replicates
statistical_plan.development_p_value_policy: no inferential p-values are used to validate claims from the repeatedly observed 30-item development set

power_and_scope.approximation: Under paired discordance assumptions, about 155 items can detect a 10-point net difference when total discordance is 20%, while about 470 items may be needed for a 5-point net difference when total discordance is 15%.
power_and_scope.warning: A formal exact power sensitivity table must be generated locally and frozen before the held-out manifest is created.

call_budget_estimate_no_authorization.basis: B1 development average 94/30 = 3.13 model calls per item; hard ceiling 6
call_budget_estimate_no_authorization.authorization: none; every live stage requires a new explicit authorization after local preregistration
